name: Fadei Kamenev
source:
"You would intercept me on the basis of a claim rooted not in fact, but in perception? I never did say that my plan was harmful—in fact, I begged to differ—yet you are now placing such foul words into my mouth."

Composed and imperturbable, Fadei's unnervingly calm nature, combined with his excessively formal manner of speaking and strangely dark outlook, can be off-putting to some. His mannerisms may at times seem odd, but he is only doing what he can to assist in finding an escape.

His coldly realistic and logical perspective can cause him to come across as something of a contrarian, especially when the subject of trust is discussed. He doesn't wish to cause tension, but his tendency to point out and criticize all possible issues can occasionally lead to conflict and fuel others' uncertainty towards him.

Beyond his refined exterior, he is a deeply empathetic person, one who cares more about addressing the individual needs of those whose preferences are less likely to be considered than the assumed "greater good".
